label: Starting price
description: The entry-level or starting price the entity charges, including the unit and billing period when given, e.g. $12 per seat per month.

label: Key features
description: The main product capabilities or things included in the offering.

label: Target audience
description: Who the entity sells to or is aimed at, e.g. enterprise teams, students, small businesses.

label: Positioning angle
description: The tagline, slogan, or main way the entity frames itself against alternatives.

label: Notable weakness
description: A gap, limitation, complaint, or thing the entity does badly or does not offer.
